images.caption: Figure 1:Collaborative personalized preference alignment under data deficiency.Left:with scarce local feedback, local-only training from a random initialization stops far from a client’s preference-specific optimum, whereas a collaboratively learned initialization enables effective few-shot personalization.Right:preliminary results on UltraFeedback(Cui et al., 2023)with Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct(Meta AI, 2024)(15 clients, 20 samples each). Over helpfulness, honesty, and truthfulness, collaborative initialization raises the pareto hypervolume (HV) from 0.728 to 0.820 (+12.6%+12.6\%), and its frontier dominates the local one in the 2D projections.
Figure 3:Communication-round ablation on UltraFeedback and Fed-ChatbotPA with Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct; each cell is APO’s normalized weighted-score gain over FedAvg, in percentage points.
